name: The Harbour Room
summary: Our quietest room, on the ground floor. Tall shutters open straight onto the water, and the terrace — and breakfast — are ten steps away.
alt: A linen-dressed bed with a claret throw beside an open shuttered window looking out to the sea
features: Step-free rain shower · Writing desk · Blackout linen curtains

name: The Balcony Suite
summary: A stone bath by open French doors, and a wrought-iron balcony wide enough for two chairs and a bottle of rosé at dusk.
alt: A freestanding stone bathtub beside open French doors and a small balcony in golden light
features: Freestanding stone bath · Private balcony · Separate sitting corner

name: The Attic Twin
summary: Two narrow beds under the old roof beams, a round window onto the cypresses, and the best-kept secret price in the house.
alt: Two single beds with striped red blankets under sloping timber beams and a round window
features: Exposed roof beams · Round garden window · Shared terrace access
